C9000196.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 196 (A counterexample to Kaplansky’s zero-divisor conjecture.; papers: A Torsion-Free Group Algebra with Zero Divisors; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/196.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_ENTROPY_FINITE.statement: Universal finite ranked-comparison projection and moment bounds, self-link obstructions, actual occurrence-matching balance and component exponent, with explicit epsilon arithmetic; precisely the formal declarations in Main.lean.

C_OCCURRENCE_CODE.statement: Root words and unconstrained target letters injectively encode assignments along an ordered spanning tree; any stage projection has no larger cardinality.

C_SELF_LINK.statement: A nonzero translation self-link with k comparisons on h positions allows at most |T|^(h-k) root words; a reflection self-link comparing more than h/2 positions allows no reduced word.

C_OCCURRENCE_BALANCE.statement: For a finite partial matching of occurrences with no pair inside a block, 2 times any block multiplicity is at most total multiplicity plus the number of unmatched occurrences.

C_WEIGHT_BINS.statement: A finite squared-word moment bound bounds the cardinality of each positive-weight bin.

C_STAGE_EXPONENT.statement: The finite stage-product exponent is at most -delta*s*S/2 + a0*s*b, with explicit propagation errors added separately.

C_ENTROPY_APPLICATION.statement: With the manuscript's bounded-chain, alignment, squared-word and prescription inputs, the finite bound gives one epsilon depending only on the types for every fixed K,C,I.

C_GRID.statement: Boundedly many chain comparisons admit the common nearly aligned subdivision and the stated o(L) uncovered-mass errors.

C_INCIDENCE.statement: Immersed paths with at most one interval path have sum_j(V_j-E_j-k_j) <= 0.

C_SQUARED.statement: For the prescribed turn weights, sum_W P(W)^2 <= exp(-2*delta*h) for all sufficiently large h.

C_PRESCRIPTIONS.statement: The conditioned matching model satisfies the uniform few-edge prescription estimate.

C_PLANAR.statement: Bounded-pattern exclusion and diameter control exclude every reduced planar arrangement.

C_TOPOLOGY.statement: Arrangement exclusion implies asphericity and separation of the prescribed roots.

C_TOPOLOGY_UNIVERSAL.statement: For every finite graph immersion into a finite rose and every prescribed root set, absence of the specified reduced arrangements implies pi_2 of the cone complex vanishes, prescribed-root separation, a contractible universal cover and torsion-freeness.

C_PICTURE_REP.statement: An essential sphere or a null-homotopy with fixed graph-path boundary has a finite cone picture with the specified actual boundary lifts.

C_SAME_EDGE_SURGERY.statement: In all four band-incidence cases a same-underlying-edge pairing strictly shortens a genuine failure picture, preserving either fixed distinct graph endpoints or an essential spherical summand.

C_CONE_CHAIN_CORE.statement: The augmented integer cellular complex of every finite graph cone is exact, with injective top differential; a closed residual cone 2-chain contributes zero under any additive pushforward, so a nonzero cut-and-cap sum has a nonzero summand.

C_TORSION_OBSTRUCTION.statement: A connected two-dimensional CW complex with pi_2=0 has contractible universal cover and torsion-free fundamental group.

C_MAIN_TORSIONZERO.statement: There exists a finitely presented torsion-free group with a finite two-dimensional classifying space and two nonzero factors over F_2 whose product is zero.
